_comment: Every third-party artifact the device payload contains, pinned by exact URL and verified by size on download. Replace `sha256: null` with the real digest after the first successful build (build_payload.py prints them), then the build becomes tamper-evident. Bumping ANY pin here is a runtime-layer version bump and requires re-running the retrieval evaluation, because a re-quantised model changes every distance the relevance cut-off in app/config.py was measured against.

python._note: python-build-standalone, NOT PyInstaller. Keeps an app update at ~140 KB instead of ~250 MB, and avoids the sys._MEIPASS temp-dir extraction that school AV watches. MUST pass the sqlite-vec extension-loading gate in install.ps1 -- see README.

ollama._note: Vendored, never installed. The official installer is per-user, adds a tray app, and SELF-UPDATES -- which across a fleet means inference behaviour changing under you between site visits. Measured: the zip is 3322 MB unpacked; keeping only ollama.exe + the CPU ggml runners is 63 MB. The 3259 MB stripped is cuda_v12/cuda_v13/hip, all dead weight on integrated-graphics laptops.

llm._note: Matches app/config.py on this branch: ollama_model=qwen2.5:1.5b, rag_embedding_model=nomic-embed-text at 768 dims. Both Apache-2.0, so unlike the multilang build (gemma2:2b under the Gemma Terms of Use) there is no model licence to pass on to each school. The corpus must be embedded with nomic-embed-text: the store refuses to mix vectors from two models, and a bge-m3 library.db will not open here.

_variant: ENGLISH ONLY. Speech is entirely browser-side on this branch -- the backend has no stt.py and no tts.py -- so no IndicConformer and no Piper voice ship. That removes 548 MB from the payload and, more importantly, removes both licensing blockers: the GPL-3.0 espeak-ng bundled with the Piper voice, and the unverified third-party re-export of the IndicConformer weights. Do not re-add the speech section without resolving those first.
